_about: A REAL answer from POST /api/p5play-convert (deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash on OpenRouter), recorded 2026-11-17 from the p5play v3 program in p5play-demo-input.js; it ran 180 frames clean in scripts/moshion-harness.mjs. The 2026-11-p5play-convert What's New clip replays it so recording spends no credit and needs no key.
notes: Everything that ran in draw() now runs in update(), because moSHion runs update() before physics and draw() only paints.
The HUD text moved to drawTop() so it draws on top of the sprites.
`bullets.overlaps(rocks, hit)` is now asked every frame in update(), and bullets were set to collider 'none' so they pass through rocks like before.
`camera.zoom = 1.2` was dropped — moSHion has no zoom, the view stays at 1x.
`world.timeScale = 0` was dropped; a `gameOver` flag stops the game instead.
`ship.img` is `ship.image`, and the extra "facing" argument of rotateTowards was removed.
